summary: Tested the OptiIQ old-style display on Long-term Analyze (advance user, MSFT), the billing status for trial/expired, trial-user unlocks, the expired-user paywall/read-only flows, Upgrade and Profile. Backend: 7/8 pass. The one failure is a design gap: the server doesn't enforce the expired lock. Frontend: almost everything works. 2 bugs: (1) trial users see Discover's 'Low risk · Higher reward' (spreads & iron condor) profile LOCKED with an 'Advance plan' upsell; (2) expired users have no way in the UI to reach Profile (no sign-out or plan management) because the only Profile entry (Discover avatar) is behind the paywall. No deprecated Expo packages detected.

critical.issue: No server-side plan enforcement. An expired user (features all 0) gets 200 from stock-analysis, alerts/add and watchlist/add. Also server.py:547 trusts the client-sent req.tier ('tier = req.tier if req.tier in TIER_RANK'), so anyone can send tier='expert' to unlock naked strategies. scans_per_day is counted (bump_scan) but never blocked. The paywall exists only in the UI.

ui_bugs.issue: tierLocked.low_high = !plan.atLeast('advance') uses TIER_RANK (trial=1 < advance=3), so trial users see 'Low risk · Higher reward' locked and a 'Spreads & iron condor profiles · Advance plan · Upgrade' lock. This contradicts 'everything in Advance' and the 'Level 3 · + spreads & iron condors' banner. Fix: use plan.features.strategy_tier >= 3 (and >= 4 for high_high) instead of atLeast().

The only way into /profile is the Discover header avatar (testID go-profile, index.tsx:117). Discover is fully wrapped by PlanGate, so expired users can't reach Profile, can't sign out and can't manage their plan. /profile works only through a direct URL. Add a Profile/Sign-out link to the PlanGate paywall, or a profile avatar to the Portfolio/Alerts/Learn headers.

issues: The plan card shows a bare '—' in the price slot next to TRIAL ENDED
The alert-usage text ('1 saved alert' / '0/20 alerts used') sits centered on its own line under the subtitle, out of line with the left-aligned header text
B-row secondary text is cut off ('-2.9% vs intri...') at 375px width
OptiIQ Value ($527.55) and Probability-weighted value ($736.58) appear on the same screen with very different values, which may confuse users (this is by design, per the user's request)
Watchlist remove button wl-remove-* is 28x28, below the 44pt minimum touch target

action_items: Fix app/(tabs)/index.tsx:57 so trial unlocks the low_high profile: use plan.features.strategy_tier >= 3 for low_high and >= 4 for high_high, not plan.atLeast().
Give expired users a path to Profile and sign-out: add a link on the PlanGate paywall (src/plans.tsx) or a profile avatar on the Portfolio/Alerts/Learn headers.

Backend: enforce compute_access on scan endpoints (block tier 'expired' with 402, enforce scans_per_day), /api/alerts/add (expired and alert count limit), /api/watchlist/add, and stop trusting req.tier from the client (server.py:547).
Minor: replace the '—' price on the expired Profile plan card; align the alert-usage text; don't truncate the B-row 'vs intrinsic' text; enlarge the wl-remove hit area (hitSlop).
critical_code_review_comments: The paywall is client-only. Nothing in server.py, strategies.py or extras.py reads features.scans_per_day, alerts or the expired tier. Clients can bypass it with direct API calls, and server.py:547 accepts the tier from the request body.

usePlan() falls back to tier 'trial' when user.access is missing (plans.tsx:47). If /me fails to send access, an expired user would get unlocked UI. Safer to default to 'expired' or wait for the data to load.
analyze.tsx is 669 lines, close to the 700-line split threshold.

success_rate.backend: 88% (7/8; the failing test is the missing server-side enforcement for expired users)
success_rate.frontend: ~90% (all requested flows pass except the trial profile lock and the missing Profile access for expired users)

seed_data_creation: None kept. A temporary TSLA alert on expired@optiscreen.app was created and removed (the UI remove flow was tested on it). The MSFT price_below 300 alert and the AAPL watchlist row are intact. A ZZZT watchlist entry was added and deleted through the API.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified OK: MSFT long shows optiiq-card ($527.55, '+0.6% vs price') with no calc table and no whatif-toggle; buy-levels B1-B4 with strength, reasons and Buy alert buttons; Intrinsic value · scenarios with scen-Bull/Base/Bear; Recalculate changes the probability-weighted value; Fundamentals shows buy/sell points. Billing: trial = tier 'trial', 7 days left, features == advance; expired = all zero. Trial user: Discover header 'Unlimited scans · Free trial · 7 days left', custom period available, smart alert kind available, chat unlocked (30 left today), backtest not locked (shows pending), Iron Condor strategy allowed, Upgrade has the Free CURRENT card plus $9/$29/$79 cards, Profile shows FREE TRIAL with 7 days left. Expired user: paywall on Discover/Analyze/Chain, See plans goes to /upgrade (upgrade-trial-ended, Free ENDED); Portfolio banner + AAPL row with no add input; ticker/AAPL paywall, Go back returns to /portfolio; Alerts banner, '1 saved alert', + goes to /upgrade, remove works; Learn and Profile (direct URL) open. Onboarding plan.tsx code-reviewed: free card is 'Free · 7-day trial' with FREE_CARD.features.
rca_of_issue: Trial profile lock: index.tsx:57 uses plan.atLeast('advance') (rank-based, trial=1). Expired Profile access: the Discover avatar is the only push('/profile'), and PlanGate replaces the whole Discover screen.
